data.name: Nauseating Flesh
data.description: The mutation warrior's body is suffused with poison. Any creature that bites, engulfs, or swallows the mutation warrior must make a Fortitude saving throw or be nauseated for 1d4 rounds. The mutation warrior with this discovery does not suffer the effect of the poison of his own nauseating flesh.
